title: Storm Sorceress Over Shipwreck
description: A purple-skinned sorceress with long flowing multicolored hair floats above a stormy sea, holding a glowing orb staff. She wears a golden crown and a pink and red gown that swirls into a vortex of magical energy, above a shipwreck with broken masts and lily pads in the foreground under a dramatic purple sky with lightning.
prompt: A majestic purple-skinned female sorceress with long flowing purple, blue and pink hair, wearing a golden crown and a dramatic pink and red gown with gold details, floats dynamically above a turbulent stormy ocean. She holds a tall ornate staff topped with a glowing blue orb. Her lower body transforms into a swirling vortex of white, blue, and multicolored magical energy. Below her is a wooden shipwreck with broken masts in churning dark waves, with green lily pads and pink water lilies in the foreground. The sky is filled with dramatic swirling purple storm clouds and bright lightning strikes, in a vibrant epic fantasy style.
